description: JLPT N5 and N4 full-depth curriculum — radicals, kanji, vocabulary, grammar, readings, and a precomputed dependency graph for bundled app import. Kanji and radicals are banded: each level teaches a fixed budget (150 / 150 / 400 / 300 / 1,000 kanji, 2,000 cumulative) ranked by how many of that level's own words each kanji unlocks, with radicals filing at the level of the first kanji that needs them. A band is a teaching budget, not a coverage gate — words outside it are still taught: a kanji banded at or before a word's level emits a gating `requires` edge, and an out-of-band kanji a non-gating `builds_on` edge, which withholds the word's reading prompt instead of the word. N3/N2/N1 carry kanji and radicals only: item lists, readings and meanings, no examples or vocabulary of their own (docs/content/kanji-coverage-and-dependency-order-plan.md).
maintainer_notes: Bump version in this file before every content publish. Run npm run validate-schema && npm run compile-curriculum from repo root, then commit mobile/assets/curriculum-seed/curriculum.db via Git LFS.
